common.tagline: Healthy habits that adapt. Progress that survives real life.

welcome.title: Welcome to Gibo
welcome.subtitle: An adaptive healthy-habit companion designed for real life in Abu Dhabi.
welcome.disclaimer: Gibo supports general daily wellness and is not a clinical medical service or diagnostic tool.

eligibility.title: Age Verification
eligibility.question: Are you 18 years of age or older?
eligibility.underageMessage: Gibo is currently designed for adults (18+). If you are under 18, please consult with a parent, guardian, or healthcare provider for age-appropriate wellness guidance.

consent.title: Privacy & Data Choices
consent.subtitle: You are in control. Choose which data permissions to grant. You can change these anytime in settings.

coreProfile.title: Account & Profile
coreProfile.desc: Stores your chosen goals, schedules, and daily habits securely. Required for Gibo to function.

healthConnect.title: Wearable & Step Sync
healthConnect.desc: Optionally reads steps from Android Health Connect. Manual check-in always earns equal XP without a wearable.

chatContext.title: Wellness Assistant History
chatContext.desc: Remembers past conversation context to improve assistance. Never used for advertising.

research.title: Anonymized Public Health Insights
research.desc: Contributes de-identified, aggregated behavior stats to community wellness studies.

goals.title: What would you like to build?
goals.subtitle: Choose one primary focus to start. Small steps build lasting routines.

movement.name: Movement
movement.desc: Gentle daily walking, stretching, and physical activity.

sleep.name: Sleep Routine
sleep.desc: Consistent bedtime cues, wind-downs, and screen-free evenings.

nutrition.name: Nutrition
nutrition.desc: Adding vegetables, hydration, and mindful meal habits.

constraints.title: Your Daily Realities
constraints.subtitle: Tell us what your days look like so tasks fit your schedule.

baseline.title: Starting Comfort
baseline.subtitle: Where does your body feel comfortable starting today?
baseline.restrictionsNotice: If you have joint discomfort, cardiovascular considerations, or pregnancy, Gibo will automatically filter out strenuous tasks and recommend physician consultation.

firstPlan.title: Your First Daily Step
firstPlan.subtitle: Here is one small, realistic action tailored to your preferences. You can adjust it before you begin.
